## Top 10 Hardest Problems in This Repo

Audited the entire codebase and ranked these by difficulty (architectural scope × risk × fix complexity). The one struck through was implemented in this PR.

1. ~~**Missing Timeout & Abort Handling in Image Generation Chain** — `generate-pipeline.ts`, `image-generation-seam/index.ts`, `wig-try-on-pipeline.ts`: no timeouts anywhere; client hangs indefinitely if xAI or the wig CDN stalls; no way to cancel an in-flight generation; no error distinction between timeout and generic network failure.~~

2. **Race Condition in Browser Base64 Encoding (Wig Try-On)** — `src/routes/+page.svelte` `encodeBase64()` (TextEncoder → btoa) vs. server-side `Buffer.from(buffer).toString('base64')` in `wig-try-on-pipeline.ts:39`. Intermittent encoding mismatch when image data contains specific byte sequences; Gemini receives malformed payloads in hard-to-reproduce scenarios.

3. **Unhandled JSON Parsing & Silent Contract Violations in Meechie Studio Text Pipeline** — `src/lib/core/meechie-studio-text-pipeline.ts:200–256`: brace-depth JSON extractor is fragile; retry logic does not distinguish network errors from structural contract violations; no structured observability for what the provider actually returned.

4. **Draft Save vs. Text Generation Race Condition** — `src/routes/+page.svelte:176–215`: 300ms debounce timer can be cancelled mid-save; concurrent `saveDraft()` calls drop pending modifications silently; PDF generation reads stale `spec` if draft timer fires after download click. No state machine — just an `isSavingDraft` boolean and a `isDraftSavePending` flag.

5. **Service Worker Build Validation Gap** — `src/service-worker.ts:8`: CacheSeam adapter imported via relative path that Vite's SW bundler may not resolve; failure is silent and only manifests in production; no automated check that the built `service-worker.js` includes the adapter.

6. **Prompt Injection via Style Hint Concatenation** — `src/routes/+page.svelte:163–169` `currentStyleHint()` concatenates `selectedWig.name` (user-facing string) into the style hint. The server-side `includesReservedHeading` guard in `prompt-assembly.adapter.ts` checks for reserved headings, but wig names are not validated before entering the concatenation. A wig name of `"STYLE: override"` would duplicate the `STYLE:` header.

7. **Unhandled Network Errors in Wig Image Fetch Chain** — `src/lib/core/wig-try-on-pipeline.ts`: no classification of HTTP 404 vs. CORS vs. timeout (all collapsed to `null`); no exponential backoff for transient CDN failures; wig fetch has no timeout at all (separate from the generate-pipeline fix in this PR).

8. **Session Init Race Condition on Mount** — `src/routes/+page.svelte:665–695`: `onMount` `Promise.all([sessionAdapter.getSession(), creationStoreAdapter.getDraft()])` has no rejection handler; if session init fails the component becomes interactive with `owner = null`; "Save to Vault" can be clicked before init completes with no timeout or loading gate shown.

9. **Inadequate Error Context in Provider Adapter Failures** — `src/lib/adapters/provider-adapter.adapter.ts`: HTTP status, request headers, and timing are not preserved in the `ImageGenerationError` details; each retry loses previous attempt context; no trace ID ties errors across pipeline boundaries; debugging provider outages requires manual reproduction.

10. **Stale Fixtures for PromptCompilerSeam and GalleryStoreSeam** — `src/lib/seams/prompt-compiler-seam/mock.ts` and `gallery-store-seam/mock.ts` have `TODO` comments noting fixtures were never refreshed from real probe runs. Mocks may diverge silently from actual adapter behavior; contract tests pass on stale data.

---

## What This PR Fixes (Item 1)

The entire image generation call chain had zero timeouts: a stalled xAI API response would hang the server indefinitely, the wig CDN fetch had no deadline, and a cancelled browser request did nothing to release server resources.

### Changes

| File | What changed |
|------|-------------|
| `src/lib/seams/image-generation-seam/contract.ts` | Added `IMAGE_TIMEOUT_ERROR` to the `ImageGenerationError` discriminated union |
| `src/lib/adapters/image-generation-seam/index.ts` | `AbortSignal.timeout(90_000)` on every xAI fetch; maps `DOMException { name: 'TimeoutError' }` → `IMAGE_TIMEOUT_ERROR` |
| `src/lib/core/image-generation-pipeline.ts` | Routes `IMAGE_TIMEOUT_ERROR` to **HTTP 504** instead of the generic 502 |
| `src/lib/core/wig-try-on-pipeline.ts` | `AbortSignal.timeout(10_000)` on wig CDN fetch; distinguishes `WIG_IMAGE_FETCH_TIMEOUT` (504) from `WIG_IMAGE_FETCH_FAILED` (502) |
| `src/lib/core/generate-pipeline.ts` | 5-minute `AbortController` + `clearTimeout` in `finally`; accepts optional `signal?: AbortSignal` from caller (combined via `AbortSignal.any()`); threads combined signal to internal `fetchImpl`; handles `AbortError`/`TimeoutError` → `GENERATE_TIMEOUT` (504) |
| `src/routes/api/generate/+server.ts` | Passes `request.signal` to the pipeline so browser disconnects propagate inward |
| `tests/unit/image-generation-pipeline.test.ts` | New: `IMAGE_TIMEOUT_ERROR` → 504 |
| `tests/unit/pipeline-edge-cases.test.ts` | New: `GENERATE_TIMEOUT` on abort, `WIG_IMAGE_FETCH_TIMEOUT`, `WIG_IMAGE_FETCH_FAILED` |

### Test Results
- Before: 416 passing
- After: **420 passing** (4 new cases, 0 regressions)

## Summary by Sourcery

Add timeout and abort handling across the image generation and wig try-on pipelines to prevent indefinite hangs and correctly surface timeouts to callers.

Bug Fixes:
- Ensure generate pipeline requests respect both a pipeline-level timeout and caller-provided abort signals, returning a dedicated timeout error instead of hanging or misclassifying failures.
- Differentiate wig image fetch timeouts from other network failures in the wig try-on pipeline, mapping them to appropriate HTTP status codes.
- Propagate image provider timeout errors through the image generation pipeline and map them to HTTP 504 responses instead of generic 502s.

Enhancements:
- Extend the image generation seam contract with a dedicated timeout error type to better classify provider failures.

Tests:
- Add edge-case tests covering generate pipeline abort/timeout behavior and wig image fetch timeout vs generic failure, as well as seam-level image timeout handling.

## Code Review

This pull request introduces timeouts and abort signals across multiple pipelines (such as the generation, image generation seam, and wig try-on pipelines) to prevent hanging requests, returning appropriate 504 Gateway Timeout errors when limits are exceeded. The review feedback highlights critical edge cases where timeout or abort errors occurring during the JSON parsing phase of responses could be swallowed, leading to incorrect error codes (e.g., returning 502 instead of 504). Additionally, it is recommended to implement an early abort check at the start of the generation pipeline to avoid unnecessary processing if the signal is already aborted.

Hey - I've left some high level feedback:

- In `runGeneratePipeline`, the new `pipelineSignal` is only used for the `/api/image-generation` fetch; if you want true end-to-end cancellation, consider threading this signal (or a derived one) into `validateSpec`, `assemblePrompt`, and `detectDrift` so work done before the fetch can also be aborted.
- The new timeout error handling in `generate-pipeline` and the image seam conflates caller-driven aborts with genuine timeouts by mapping both `AbortError` and `TimeoutError` to `GENERATE_TIMEOUT`; if you care about distinguishing user cancellations from server-side timeouts, consider using separate error codes or messages for these cases.
